THE STYLE TARGET IS NAMED AND IT IS TWO LIVE FILES, NOT A DESCRIPTION. skingenetix-loss-of-skin-firmness-collagen-elastin-cross-section.jpg and skingenetix-collagen-peptide-firming-skin-structure-diagram.jpg, blocks `causes` and `approach` on /pages/firming-skin-density. Square 2048x2048, as every image in a media-with-text section must be — the row height is set by the master's own aspect, so a non-square file would make this block taller than its siblings.

  1  QUILTED SURFACE   soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach, slightly felted
  2  SMOOTH FILM       a thin band of pale cream, faintly laminated at the cut edge
  3  GRANULAR BAND     small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely, a fine foam of tiny cells
  4  BASE PLATE        a thin smooth peach plate
  5  FIBRE LAYER       long thick glossy PEARL-WHITE bundles in loose parallel horizontal waves
  6  DERMAL FLOOR      a second thin smooth peach plate
  7  FAT CUSHION       two rows of large smooth glossy rounded lobules, pearly cream-blush
  8  GLASS BASE        a clear colourless acrylic plate

WARM SOLUTION PALETTE ON A RESEARCH PAGE, DELIBERATELY. This store has two explainer families — the research pages run cool (teal and clinical blue) and the solution pages run 100% warm. Malcolm named the warm firming pair as the target, and the parallel brief written this morning for /pages/pdrn-research made the same call for the same reason. The warm ladder is inherited unchanged: F3E3DB warm blush-cream ground, F2DACC pale peach bulk tissue, E0B6A1 mid coral-peach surface cells, CB8F76 deep coral divider rules, F5EFE8 glossy cream-ivory fibre and pearls. CONTRAST IS BOUGHT WITH STRATA, NOT SHADOWS: every band is a different colour AND a different geometric motif with a hard edge between them. A candidate whose layers dissolve into soft gradients has failed however pretty it is.

=== THE ONE STRUCTURAL IDEA, AND IT EXISTS TO AVOID DUPLICATING A LIVE IMAGE ===

THERE IS ALREADY A GLUTATHIONE DIAGRAM ON THIS STORE, TWO CLICKS AWAY. /pages/brightening-glow carries skingenetix-glutathione-antioxidant-brightening-approach-skin-diagram.jpg on its `approach` block and skingenetix-multi-pathway-brightening-system-glutathione-skin-cross-section.jpg on `together`. Both already show glass spheres holding three-bead glutathione chains, shafts of warm light descending into the layers, and fine dark grey angular motes breaking apart. A generic 'glutathione defeats free radicals' picture made for this block would be a near-copy of a file a shopper can reach from the same menu.

SO THE COMPOSITION IS INVERTED, AND THE INVERSION IS ALSO THE HONEST READING OF THE STUDY. In every explainer this store has made so far the event is an ACTIVE DESCENDING INTO THE SKIN, and the direction of interest is downward delivery. Grandi 2019 is not a delivery finding. It measured minimal erythema dose — how much more the skin could take before it reddened — which is a RESILIENCE finding. So here:
  ARRIVING     environmental stress comes IN FROM OUTSIDE, from above: two broad soft shafts of pale
               warm daylight slanting down from the upper corners, with small dark ANGULAR motes
               drifting down inside them and through the air between them. Angular is the whole
               device — they are the only sharp-cornered things in a picture otherwise made entirely
               of soft round forms, so a viewer sorts them from the tissue without a label.
  ANSWERING    the defence is ALREADY IN PLACE, in and just above the quilted pads: a gentle warm-white
               bloom with no edge, no rim and no surface, fed by the spheres resting on the surface.
               The motes come apart in it — whole and dark high up, crumbling and pale lower down,
               nothing dark left at the pads. Not one reaches the skin intact.
Same camera, same stack, same palette, opposite direction of interest. That is a different picture, not a recoloured one.

THE MOLECULE IS A SPEC, NOT A LOOK. Glutathione is a TRIPEPTIDE: EXACTLY THREE pearl-white beads linked in a straight row, three and no more, plainly countable at 100%. This count is already the established house depiction — the brightening pair set it and the fine-lines r3 brief cites it as the precedent for counting every chain on this store. The study active is S-ACYL glutathione, so a SINGLE SLENDER SMOOTH TAPERING STRAND trails from one end of the chain like a fine tail. The tail is a plain strand and is NOT a fourth bead; a candidate whose chain reads as four beads has failed and the check is a count at 100% zoom, not a glance. This tail is also what tells this frame's molecule apart from the plain three-bead chains on the brightening page.

NO VITAMIN C, AND THAT IS A CONTENT DECISION. The brightening diagrams carry a second active — stable vitamin C as a single colourless faceted crystal — because that page's copy is about a multi-active system. This block's copy names one thing, a 2% S-acyl glutathione cream, and nothing else. Faceted crystals, gemstones and jewels are negated by name so no engine adds a second active the study did not test.

NO REDNESS ANYWHERE, WHICH IS THE EASIEST THING TO GET WRONG HERE. The copy says 'greater resilience to UV-induced redness'. An engine that reads 'UV' and 'redness' draws sunburn, and a picture of inflamed skin on a page selling a cosmetic is both an unpleasant frame and a condition depiction the copy does not make. The tissue is EVENLY COLOURED FROM END TO END, the same calm soft peach everywhere. Redness, erythema, sunburn, irritation and peeling are negated by name AND the evenness is stated positively in every prompt body — positively because Luma has no negative-prompt field and the runner drops negatives for it entirely, so anything that matters must live in the prompt itself.

UV IS DRAWN AS DAYLIGHT, NOT AS A COLOUR. Ultraviolet is invisible and the usual shorthand for it is a violet or purple beam, which is both false and already barred by this family's palette. Pale warm daylight slanting in from the corners reads 'outdoors, environment' without asserting a wavelength. The airborne motes carry the rest of the meaning — the copy says 'environmental oxidative stress', which is broader than UV, so light and air both bring something.

NO SHIELD. The bloom must not become a dome, a rim, a force field, a glass canopy or anything with a surface and an edge. Those read as sci-fi and, worse, as a sunscreen claim — this is a cream studied for antioxidant support, not an SPF, and a barrier over the skin says otherwise. The defence is the surface layer GLOWING, nothing more. Shield, dome, force field, barrier wall and armour are negated by name.

CLAIMS DISCIPLINE. Depicted: arrival of stress, interception, and a local response falling off with distance — the mechanism-propagating-through-tissue device this family established. NOT depicted: any before-and-after, any comparison, any number, any percentage (the p-value and the MED belong to the words), any measurement, any face. NOTHING INJECTED — needle, syringe, cannula and filler negated, because this is a topical and an injectable read would be false and regulated. And nothing bleached, lifted or erased: this block is about defence, not lightening, and the page's own FAQ answers 'is glutathione safe for all skin tones?'.

NO BRAND COLOUR, matching the firming pair. Teal is Matrixyl's, clinical blue and copper are the copper-peptide page's. This is generic skin: peach-cream tissue, pearl-ivory fibre, warm cream haze, smoky grey-taupe motes, and the only bright thing in frame is the warm white of the bloom.

HANDEDNESS: not a constraint, and deliberately so. `key_findings` runs alternate_media_position, so f2 sits image-right with its text to the left while f1 and f3 sit the other way. Rather than lean the composition to suit one side, the stress arrives symmetrically from BOTH upper corners, so the frame reads the same whichever way the row is dealt.

CLASS B — no product in frame, no references attached, no product description and no brand identity given to any engine. FLUX.2 is in the run.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AGAIN AT RENDER SIZE (this block draws at 660px at 1440 and 350px at 390). Four checks: BEAD COUNT, exactly three plus a tail that is not a bead; NO DARK MOTE touching or embedded in the tissue; NO REDDENED PATCH anywhere in the block; and LAYER SEPARATION, because the granular band and the fibre zone go soft and merge on downscale and that is what kills a candidate that looked fine full-size.

slots.title: A · family match: stress falling from both corners, motes breaking apart in the surface bloom
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy warm cream gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level with the middle of the block and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge and fills the lower three quarters of the height, leaving clear hazy air above it. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte, and it is EVENLY COLOURED FROM END TO END — the same calm soft peach everywhere, with no reddened, blotchy, sore or irritated area anywhere in the picture.

THE LAYERS SIT DIRECTLY ON ONE ANOTHER, IN CONTACT, one solid continuous slab. From top to bottom, in this exact order: a narrow band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; then, filling the middle of the block, a deep zone of long thick glossy fibre bundles in a pale pearl ivory, almost white with only the faintest warm gold in their highlights, lying in loose parallel horizontal waves through a soft peach-cream ground, glassy and translucent and crisply defined against it, every bundle whole and solid with no cut or open ends; a second thin smooth peach plate; and at the bottom a deep cushion of large smooth glossy rounded lobules in a pearly cream-blush, packed in two rows like a bed of eggs. The whole block stands on a thin clear colourless glass plate. Each band is a different colour and a different shape from the ones above and below it, with a clean hard edge between them, so the stack reads as seven distinct materials and not as a gradient.

ENVIRONMENTAL STRESS IS ARRIVING FROM ABOVE, AND IT IS THE EVENT OF THE PICTURE. Two broad shafts of pale warm daylight slant down into the frame, one from the upper left corner and one from the upper right, wide and soft-edged and hazy like light travelling through air, meeting the surface at an angle. Drifting down inside them, and through the air between them, are many SMALL DARK ANGULAR MOTES — tiny sharp-cornered chips and splinters of smoky grey-taupe, matte and irregular and quite plain, the only angular things in a picture otherwise made entirely of soft round forms. They are falling toward the skin.

THE DEFENCE IS ALREADY IN PLACE AND IT IS SOFT, NOT A BARRIER. Lying in and just above the quilted surface pads is a gentle luminous bloom of warm white light, like breath on cold glass — brightest inside the pads themselves and fading upward into the air over a shallow depth. It has no edge, no rim, no outline and no surface of its own; it is simply the surface layer glowing.

WHERE THE MOTES MEET THE BLOOM THEY COME APART. Each one that reaches it breaks into a scatter of fine pale dust with a small soft glint at the moment it goes, and the dust fades to nothing within the bloom. High in the frame, well above the skin, the motes are still whole, dark and sharp-edged; lower down they are already crumbling and paler; at the pads themselves nothing dark remains at all. Not one mote reaches the skin whole and none is resting on it or buried in it.

FLOATING IN THE HAZY AIR JUST ABOVE THE SURFACE ARE FOUR TRANSLUCENT SPHERES OF CLEAR PALE GLASS, of slightly different sizes and at slightly different heights, sitting low and close to the pads. EACH HOLDS A SHORT CHAIN OF EXACTLY THREE SMALL PEARL-WHITE BEADS linked in a neat straight row — three beads and no more, plainly countable — and from one end of each chain a SINGLE SLENDER SMOOTH TAPERING STRAND trails away like a fine tail, a plain strand and not another bead. Each sphere rests down onto the quilted surface, and a soft warm glow spreads out from where it touches, feeding the bloom: directly beneath each sphere the pads are brightest and the bloom is deepest, easing off smoothly with distance along the block so the light is uneven, with no line and no edge anywhere.

Nothing in the tissue is broken, frayed, damaged or discoloured, and no dark speck is embedded anywhere in it. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
